messages:
natalie_p: following the postmortem, we saw repeated tiny/partial chunks and client reconnect storms across multiple regions. need three clear owners: detection, server mitigations, and client guidance. postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/streaming-2026-q1. who volunteers? :clipboard:

ops-bot: incident logged: STREAM-2026-APR partial-chunk + reconnect-pattern (sev3).

irene: i'll take detection and triage. plan: add metric stream.partial_probable (per-cluster, per-model), emit a trace tag "partial_probe=1" for suspected short-first-chunk cases, and create a compact console view for SRE. ETA metrics+dashboard by 2472001200.

benji: i'll own server-side mitigations. short runway: implement a token quarantine (no new streams for 60s when a token triggers >5 partials/min), add a 2s graceful drain window to allow final chunk flushes, and a per-instance circuit to limit new connections when instance error-rate spikes. feature flags behind rollout. ETA PR + canary by 2472002400.

marco: i'll own client guidance and SDK changes. recommendation: client backoff defaults base=300ms, max=5s, max_retries=5, plus a per-token concurrency knob default 6. SDK will emit telemetry when it auto-throttles. ETA SDK PR and short migration note by 2472003000.

natalie_p: immediate, reversible mitigations we can flip in prod within hours: 1) set token concurrency to 6, 2) enable low-sensitivity partial alert, 3) enable token quarantine feature-flag. who can flip 1+3 quickly?

benji: i can flip (1) and enable quarantine flag for a 2h test window, will monitor p95 and error-rate.

ops-bot: feature flag update queued: token_concurrency=6 by benji (staging->prod).

irene: detection detail: runtime will mark trace attribute partial_probe=1 when first chunk size < 24 bytes and connection closes within 120ms. this avoids parsing bodies and is cheap to compute.

marco: SDK policy: if client sees telemetry indicating partial_probe >=3 for a token in 10m, SDK reduces concurrency by 50% for that token and inserts a 2s cooldown. opt-out via client.enableAutoThrottle=false.

benji: server example config being tested: """
stream:
  drain_window_ms: 2000
  token_quarantine_s: 60
  max_streams_per_token: 6
  noisy_token_threshold_per_min: 5
"""

irene: tests: add a reproducible injection in streaming-e2e that emits many tiny first-chunks and asserts partial_probe traces and metric increments. include a lightweight replay harness for SRE.

natalie_p: add rollback gates: auto-revert if canary p95 > baseline *1.25 for 10m or if 5xx rate increases >10% for 15m. annotate flags with playbook link and required on-call.

benji: adding automated revert and will post canary dashboard link here once live.

marco: i'll include code snippet in SDK notes and a short changelog entry. example migration snippet: ```js
client.configure({ maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken: 6, enableAutoThrottle: true })
```

irene: propose daily 10m stand for rollout week and a final closure update in 7 days or when metrics stable.

natalie_p: action summary:
- detection & dashboard: owner @irene, deliverable metric+trace+console view, due 2472001200
- server mitigations: owner @benji, deliverable quarantine+drain+circuit+canary, due 2472002400
- SDK/client guidance: owner @marco, deliverable SDK PR+migration notes+telemetry, due 2472003000

ops-bot: calendar event created: Streaming Reliability Triage (recurring Tue 9:30am PT) by natalie_p.

benji: opening tracker STREAM-TKT-7088 with subtasks and links to this thread. will update after canary. keep updates short. :rocket:
